integrity: Geometric fixed points are identified by a direct orbit-barycenter PL model; vertex folds preserve simple homotopy and are proved uniformly. The finite checker corroborates selected cases but does not replace the infinite proof. Originality is subject to unindexed earlier literature.
scientific_limitations: Fixed spaces of each label permutation, for n>=2 and generalized depth ell>=2; no equivariant equivalence between entire complexes, no orbit-space quotient homotopy, no integral representation decomposition. The published nonequivariant homotopy formulas are credited.
title: Geometric fixed-point homotopy of generalized Mycielskian independence complexes
